title: Dozens of Orcas Took Down a Blue Whale. Here's How

scenes.text: Dozens of killer whales hunted the biggest animal on Earth.
In 2019, off southwest Australia, scientists watched them take down a blue whale seventy-two feet long.
They rammed its sides, bit its head, and covered its blowhole so it couldn't breathe.
Researchers recorded three kills between 2019 and 2021. These were the first ever documented.
A blue whale weighs far more than any orca. Together, they won anyway.
Dozens of killer whales. One blue whale. Teamwork won.

description:
Dozens of killer whales hunted a blue whale, the biggest animal on Earth.
Scientists recorded three kills off southwest Australia between 2019 and 2021, the first ever documented.
Could you have believed it without the footage?
first_comment: A blue whale can outweigh dozens of orcas put together. How does a pack even begin that fight?
